An independently written direct coefficient/permutation reconstruction reproduces 144 classes and exact five-term histogram; the cubic/quartic calculation gives 3·4−(2+6)=4 for each omitted-point triple, two quartic partners per cubic and eight cubics per quartic. A temporary transcription discrepancy in the independent class matrix was isolated against the actual Git blob and corrected before reproducing the count. Global divisor pairing is explicitly distinguished from local point multiplicity.
